{
  "name": "catnap",
  "displayName": "catnap",
  "version": "0.3.5",
  "description": "Claude compacts its own conversation at a clean break, then carries on by itself. A gentle note at 50% context, a strict one at 60%, Claude Code's auto-compact at 70% as the backstop, and a compact_now tool. All three lines are settings.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Martin Lipp",
    "url": "https://github.com/LippInc"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap",
  "repository": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap#privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://github.com/LippInc/catnap/blob/main/LICENSE",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "catnap",
    "claude-code",
    "compact",
    "compaction",
    "auto-compact",
    "context",
    "context-window",
    "handoff",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "soft_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Soft line (% of context)",
      "description": "From here Claude is told once to finish the piece it is on, then save and compact at that clean break. Set it at or above the strict line to turn this note off.",
      "default": 50,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 99
    },
    "strict_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Strict line (% of context)",
      "description": "From here Claude is told to save and compact now, again every 2 points until it does.",
      "default": 60,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 99
    },
    "auto_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Auto-compact line (% of context)",
      "description": "Where Claude Code's own auto-compact runs if Claude has not compacted by then. Keep it above the strict line. 0 leaves Claude Code's own setting alone. Claude Code can only move auto-compact earlier than its default, so values near 100 do nothing.",
      "default": 70,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 99
    },
    "save_step": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Save command (optional)",
      "description": "A command Claude runs to save its work before compacting, such as /save-before-compact. Empty: Claude writes a handoff file itself.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
